| [ADR-103](../../../record/decisions.d/ADR-103.md) | A line rightful-power is added beside dependence-and-domination and organizational-normativity, without moving any entry out of them: its root questions carry it first, and an entry carries it when it takes part in its argument | On the owner's decision of 2026-11-18 ("go ahead with the line, first-line option"), the closed lines vocabulary gains rightful-power, "Rightful power: restriction, answerability and rights", for the argument filed from the exchange "Assess Depp Heard Abuse". Unlike [ADR-100](../../../record/decisions.d/ADR-100.md)'s split, it is additive: no entry loses a line. Its six root questions, the owner's, carry it first and keep their earlier lines after it. Every other entry carries it, after its own lines, exactly when [ADR-085](../../../record/decisions.d/ADR-085.md) says so: it answers, objects to or bears on a root question, or refines one. Where an entry argued a root question without saying so, the relation was written with a reason; no entry was given the line by hand. | [ADR-109](../../../record/decisions.d/ADR-109.md) | The record keeps its research opportunities as LEADs, plans to advance a question or claim by any method, with a status for whether each is still worth following and a stage for how far it is worked out; and a question may presuppose another | The record's research opportunities were scattered: proposed-study CASEs (54, 28 of them bearing on no question), "What would answer it?" prose on 264 of 451 open questions, and proposed tests in dated notes. Nothing said which were still wanted, how far each was worked out, or which waited on which, and an opportunity that was not an experiment had no form at all. The owner asked on 2026-11-19 for a better way to represent this backlog, and supported dependencies among questions. A new scheme, LEAD, holds a plan to advance a question or claim: by reading, conceptual or formal work, a study, a history, or working out how a question could be advanced at all. Its status (Open, Done, Dropped, Superseded) says whether it is still worth following; a separate `stage` (idea, specified, underway) how far it is worked out. It `advances` questions and claims, may be `operationalized_in` a CASE that holds its design, and may `presuppose` a lead or a question. Questions gain `presupposes`, after THEORY's ([ADR-029](../../../record/decisions.d/ADR-029.md)). Rejected: a "What would advance it?" section on every question; decision gates on claims; more fields on CASE; a backlog file outside the record. | Proposed — Amended by ADR-111 (2026-11-20): a priority and a blocked_on note, a costed stage after specified, advances widened to readings and terms, and the converse blurbs corrected. |
| [ADR-111](../../../record/decisions.d/ADR-111.md) | LEADs get a priority for triage and a blocked_on note; the stage ladder separates a specified design from a costed one; a lead may advance a reading or a term as well as a question or claim; and derived converses are stated as computed, not stored | Carries out recommendations 1 to 5 of [POSTMORTEM-002](../../../record/postmortems.d/POSTMORTEM-002.md), the review of [ADR-109](../../../record/decisions.d/ADR-109.md) after the backlog audit filed 184 leads. A `priority` (high, medium, low) for triage, backfilled from the audit's ratings (59 high, 125 medium). The stage `specified` no longer needs a cost, which no source gave; a new stage `costed` holds what does; 53 leads whose design is in a CASE move from idea to specified, and one to costed. A plain `blocked_on` field says what a lead waits on that the record cannot do; two reading leads carry one. `advances` may name a THEORY (a replication that would meet its promote_when) or a TERM (the operationalization it waits on), with `advanced_by` derived on both. The blurbs of the derived converses now say they are computed for every reader and never stored, which is how luria treats a directed pair; they had said they were written by `luria link --fix`. QUESTION `presupposes` is kept, unused, until a sweep of question dependencies. Rejected: sorting the index by priority in place of line; a `blocked` status; dropping question dependencies; storing the converses. | Proposed |
| [ADR-112](../../../record/decisions.d/ADR-112.md) | The record keeps postmortems as POSTMORTEMs, reviews of how a change to the record has worked out once used, which review the decisions behind the change, link the pull requests that carried it and the discussions that asked for the review, and name the decisions their recommendations prompt | On 2026-11-20 the owner asked for a postmortem of the session's changes to luria.yaml, then for a scheme to hold such reviews, related to the decisions they review, with the pull requests and the discussion linked. A new scheme, POSTMORTEM: it `reviews` one or more ADRs (converse `reviewed_by`, derived on ADR), may name the decisions its recommendations `prompted` (converse `prompted_by`), and carries `pull_requests` and `discussions` as URL lists. Statuses Draft, Accepted, Superseded. Rejected: a curation entry; a workbench entry; new history versions on each reviewed ADR; reviews as dated notes on the ADRs. | Proposed |
